description: The state plans to introduce AI certificate and diploma programmes through existing institutions while work on legislation, infrastructure and a dedicated AI campus gathers pace.
body_lead: Karnataka will begin offering artificial intelligence (AI) courses through existing higher education institutions before establishing its proposed AI University, with the state targeting launch of full-fledged institution within the next three years, a senior government official said. Speaking at Rising Bharat Summit in Bengaluru, LK Atheeq, finance adviser to CM DK Shivakumar, said AI University is a flagship initiative aimed at positioning Karnataka as a global AI hub. The government has already begun discussions with industry leaders and academic institutions to shape the project.
